bio: Surf coach on the Pacific. Dawn patrol, glassy sets and the quiet before the first wave.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his early 30s with sun-bleached hair and salt on his shoulders, beach sunrise behind him, relaxed smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a Pacific beach at dawn with glassy waves and a lone surfer silhouette far away, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Dawn patrol, glassy sets
videos.description: Paddling out before the wind picks up.
videos.still: Wide photograph of clean glassy ocean waves at dawn with a surfer paddling far away in pink and orange light, no face, no text
videos.motion: Waves roll in cleanly and the surfer paddles over a swell, light glows, slow camera drift.

videos.title: Barrel from the beach
videos.description: A wave peeling along the point.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a large turquoise wave curling into a barrel on a point break with spray in the air, a distant surfer silhouette, golden light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The wave curls and peels along the point while spray drifts in the golden light, slow steady camera.

videos.title: Waxing the board
videos.description: Circles of wax, sand and morning light.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand rubbing wax on a surfboard deck in circles, sandy feet nearby, morning light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hand moves in slow circles and wax shavings glint, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Sunset session, last wave
videos.description: Orange sky, long shadows and a last ride in.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a surfer far away riding a wave at sunset with orange reflections on the water, no face, no text
videos.motion: The surfer rides the wave toward the shore, the water glows orange, slow camera pan.
